HTMLDocument.prototype.source: Chromium, as every engine ships it: Object.getPrototypeOf(document) is HTMLDocument.prototype, whose prototype is Document.prototype; window.HTMLDocument is its own interface object, whose prototype is Document; HTMLDocument.prototype has its own constructor (HTMLDocument) and @@toStringTag ("HTMLDocument", non-writable, configurable). @webref/idl has no HTMLDocument (HTML makes window.HTMLDocument an alias of Document). Spec §4.

angular-fesm-packages.source: @angular/* 13.0.0 through 19.2.10 ship fesm2022 maps whose sources are ../../../../../../packages/<pkg>/src/…, with no Bazel directory (19.2.11 and later name the Bazel directory, which the angular-bazel rule names); composed by a bundler, they climb two or more ../ into packages/<pkg>/ (spec §10).

next-webpack-build.source: Next webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/build/…, which no framework path rule names (spec §10).

next-webpack-lib.source: Next webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/lib/…, which no framework path rule names (spec §10).

next-webpack-shared.source: Next webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/shared/…, which no framework path rule names (spec §10).

angular-bazel.source: @angular/* packages built with Bazel ship maps into their Bazel output, <platform>-fastbuild-ST-<hash>/bin/packages/<pkg>/… (k8, darwin_arm64, …), which composes anywhere in a build's paths (spec §10).

next-webpack-client.source: Next 16.3.6 webpack builds compose next's shipped maps to webpack://_N_E/../../src/client/…, 231 of 426 sources (spec §10).
